sections.eyebrow: Why You Feel Heavy Every Morning
sections.headline: Modern Life May Be Quietly Burdening Your Liver
sections.body: Today's lifestyle — processed foods, occasional alcohol, chronic stress, and environmental exposure — puts daily demands on the liver that many people never consider. When the liver is under pressure, the body's natural rhythm can fall behind, leaving you waking up feeling puffy, sluggish, or less refreshed. Supporting your liver's daily reset may be the missing piece behind how light and energized you feel each morning.
bullets: Processed foods and stress can strain natural detox pathways
Liver burden may show up as bloating, fog, and fatigue
Most people never connect these feelings to liver wellness

sections.headline: Nature's Most Studied Liver Herb — Standardized to Clinical Potency
sections.body: For centuries, milk thistle has been trusted as a natural liver supporter. Its active compound, silymarin — standardized to a clinical 80% threshold — has been researched for its ability to help protect liver cells from oxidative stress, support healthy liver enzyme levels, and promote the body's natural detox pathways. Paired with turmeric and inositol, each capsule is built to support your body's natural overnight recovery rhythm.
bullets: 80% silymarin — the benchmark for meaningful liver support
Turmeric helps calm oxidative stress from within
Inositol supports healthy metabolism and fat processing

sections.headline: 8 Active Botanicals. One Clean Daily Capsule.
sections.body: Lumora keeps the formula focused and potent — no fillers, no fluff. Each capsule is led by 80% standardized silymarin milk thistle, supported by inositol, turmeric (95% curcuminoids), vitamin C, pueraria extract, wormwood, clove, and L-methionine. Every ingredient was chosen to support liver wellness, gut comfort, and daily vitality in a single, easy-to-take serving.

Inositol + Turmeric — blood sugar balance and antioxidant defense

faqs.question: Where can I buy Lumora Milk Thistle Detox?
faqs.answer: Lumora Milk Thistle Detox is available exclusively through our official website. This lets us ensure freshness, quality, and the best pricing — without middlemen or retail markup.

faqs.question: What ingredients are in each capsule?
faqs.answer: Each capsule contains 8 active botanicals: milk thistle extract (80% silymarin), inositol, turmeric extract (95% curcuminoids), vitamin C, pueraria extract, wormwood, clove, and L-methionine. No fillers, no artificial additives.

faqs.question: Is it safe to take with my current medications?
faqs.answer: Lumora Milk Thistle is formulated with natural, plant-based ingredients that are generally well-tolerated. If you take medications or have an existing health condition, consult your healthcare provider before starting any new supplement.

faqs.question: How and when should I take it?
faqs.answer: Take two capsules daily with water, preferably with a meal. Consistent daily use delivers the best long-term support for your liver, digestion, and overall wellness.

faqs.question: How long until I start noticing a difference?
faqs.answer: Many users notice less bloating and smoother digestion within the first week or two. Steadier energy and a lighter overall feeling often become more noticeable with consistent use over four to eight weeks.

faqs.question: What if it doesn't work for me?
faqs.answer: If you're not satisfied within 30 days of receiving your order, contact our support team and we'll walk you through a simple return for a full refund. Your experience is our priority.
